rationale: The paper 'Modeling the dispersion measure—redshift relation for fast radio bursts' (s2) directly investigates models relating dispersion measures and redshift, while 'Host Galaxy Dispersion Measure of Fast Radio Burst' (2309.07751) provides observational data on dispersion measures from host galaxies. Together, they contribute substantive evidence on the relationship between dispersion measures and redshift, but do not fully settle the question.
